title: phylokit-mcp: phylogenetic inference over the Model Context Protocol, never returning a topology without its support
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for phylogenetic inference, driving IQ-TREE 2 through piqtree. It enforces one structural rule: a topology without support is not a result. Tree inference always runs a bootstrap and always returns per-clade support, with no flag to skip it. Threads are pinned before the engine is imported, because likelihood sums accumulate in a thread-dependent order and unpinned runs are not reproducible.
